thread:
Nina (CSE): ACME mobile sees intermittent 429s and a couple 401s during the first 10 minutes after deploy. happens on iOS only.
Omar (Eng): do we have client logs + response headers?
Nina (CSE): snippet below. all calls hit /v1/init and sometimes a refresh comes back 401 right after a 429:
```
Request: POST /v1/init Host: api.redwood.example
Authorization: Bearer <ephemeral-token>
Response: 429 Too Many Requests
x-rate-limit-limit: 120
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rate-limit-reset: 1700000100
---
Then a follow-up refresh: 401 Unauthorized token_expired
```
Jun (Support): likely a startup stampede: multiple devices hitting init in parallel + short token TTLs. Are they rotating tokens per session?
ACME Mobile: yes we rotate every 5m, and our app creates a new chat session that calls init on each open.
Omar (Eng): two immediate mitigations: bump client SDK to 0.9.3 (client-side singleflight/debounce) and we can provision a temporary warmup bypass or short quota bump for their account during onboarding.
Nina (CSE): they are on 0.9.0. we'll ask them to upgrade.
Jun (Support): 0.9.3 exposes initDebounceMs and reuses init results for small windows. Recommend initDebounceMs=3000 and keep token TTL >= 2 minutes to avoid refresh overlap.
Omar (Eng): I'll open an infra ticket for a temporary quota raise and warmup bypass for account 34721; needs SRE signoff.
deploy-bot: Deploy request created: infra/issue-#1722 1 warmup-bypass for acct 34721 proposed. Canary scheduled 2024-11-20T22:00Z. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/warmup-bypass
Liz (CSM): ACME can run a staged ramp tonight at 22:00 PST after they upgrade. I will coordinate a support window.
Nina (CSE): sending them the 0.9.3 binary + config example:
```
// iOS config
RedwoodSDK.configure(
  apiKey: "<ephemeral>",
  initDebounceMs: 3000,
  autoRetry: true
)
```
Jun (Support): ask them to capture x-rate-limit-* headers during the ramp (10 -> 100 -> 1000 devices) and post results. we'll correlate with infra metrics.
ACME Mobile: will run tonight and share logs. thanks folks. :thumbsup:
